iść.gloss: to go, to walk (on foot, one direction)

pójść.gloss: to go, to set off (on foot)

jechać.gloss: to go, to ride (in a vehicle, one direction)

pojechać.gloss: to go, to set off (in a vehicle)

wiedzieć.partnerNote: dowiedzieć się means to find out, a different act, not a partner of wiedzieć

móc.partnerNote: móc has no perfective partner — potrafić and dać radę are separate verbs

musieć.partnerNote: musieć is always imperfective — there is no finished version of must

zobaczyć.gloss: to see, to catch sight of

zacząć.gloss: to begin, to start (and get started)

jeździć.gloss: to go, to ride (in a vehicle, back and forth)

chodzić.gloss: to go, to walk (on foot, back and forth)

stać.gloss: to stand (usually standing still for a while; stanąć is a single act of standing up or taking a position)
